requiredVisualFacts: Late-forties woman with a narrow heart-oval face, pale blue-grey eyes, fine brows and modest lips.
Small messy dark-brown bob with wisps and modest crown volume, not dense glamorous curls.
Huge round thin-wire glasses and an open, animated, slightly frazzled warmth.
Oversized pointed white collar under a cherry-red textured sweater layer reads immediately as a 1995 teacher outfit.
prohibitedContradictions: No elderly face, silver hair, deep wrinkles, grandmother styling or hunched posture.
No voluminous salon curls, heavy arched brows, sultry half-smile or fashion makeup.
No ornate chain glasses, paisley blouse, teal embroidered cardigan or book brooch.
No visible text, logo, watermark, malformed hand or duplicate accessory.
